Class LeaderboardRepository

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am23.persistence.LeaderboardRepository
public final class LeaderboardRepository extends Object
JDBC-backed repository that persists the per-match scores and serves the leaderboard queries. The repository fails open: if any error occurs the persistence is silently disabled and the game keeps running without leaderboard support.

      public LeaderboardRepository(DatabaseConfig config)
      Builds a new repository bound to the supplied configuration. Persistence is disabled immediately if the configuration is invalid.
      Parameters:
      config - the JDBC configuration

  • Method Details

    • isAvailable

      public boolean isAvailable()
      Returns:
      true if persistence is currently available

    • init

      public void init()
      Loads the JDBC driver, opens a connection and creates the schema if missing. On any error the repository is marked as unavailable so later calls become no-ops.

      Persists the result of a single player in a match.

    • positionOf

      public int positionOf(int score, int playerCount)
      Computes the global 1-based position the supplied score would have in the leaderboard restricted to matches with the same number of players.
      Parameters:
      score - score to rank
      playerCount - player count slice to query
      Returns:
      the 1-based position, or -1 if persistence is unavailable

    • topForPlayerCount

      public List<RankingEntry> topForPlayerCount(int playerCount, int limit)
      Returns the top limit entries for the supplied player count slice, ordered by descending score (and ascending match date as tie breaker).
      Parameters:
      playerCount - player count slice to query
      limit - maximum number of entries to return
      Returns:
      the matching entries; empty list if persistence is unavailable
